form.official-title: To amend title 41, United States Code, to provide best value through the multiple award schedule program, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Value Over Cost Act of 2026.

section.header: Providing best value through the multiple award schedule program
section.text: Section 152(3)(B) of title 41, United States Code, is amended by striking lowest overall cost alternative and inserting best value.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives July 21, 2026.
